title: Antipodal weather twins exist right now
body: Steinhaus popularised that at any moment there are antipodal points on Earth with equal temperature and equal pressure simultaneously, a corollary of the Borsuk-Ulam theorem applied to two weather fields at once. It needs continuity and a spherical Earth, offering existence with no address. Surveyors of the impossible should note it gives no method to find them, only certainty they are there.
